# Database Best Practices

> Proven patterns for Drizzle ORM, Postgres migrations, indexing, and multi-tenant data layout.

## Entries

- [Drizzle-Kit `--custom` Workflow for Data Backfill + NOT NULL Flip](drizzle-custom-backfill-flow.md): Schema-first, then `--custom` stub, then hand-written backfill + NOT NULL ALTER in dependency order; verify journal `when` monotonicity. RECOMMENDED.
- [Never Renumber Applied Migrations](never-renumber-applied-migrations.md): Applied migration filenames are immutable history; document duplicate prefixes in a README and adopt a strict next-number convention instead of renaming. FOUNDATIONAL.
- [Export Synchronous sqlite Helpers Alongside Async-Wrapped Store Methods](sync-sqlite-transactions-in-async-stores.md): better-sqlite3's `db.transaction()` requires a synchronous callback -- calling a store's `async`-wrapped methods from inside one lets COMMIT fire before awaited work completes, silently breaking atomicity. Export plain sync functions the async methods thinly wrap, and call those directly in multi-table transactions. RECOMMENDED.
- [Enforce a per-owner cap by chaining count-then-insert per owner in process, and name the advisory-lock upgrade](serialise-count-then-insert-per-owner-with-an-in-process-chain.md): Enforce a per-owner cap on one replica by chaining count and insert per owner in process, and name the advisory-lock upgrade for more replicas. RECOMMENDED.
- [Mutation-test a migration's verification script with deliberate defects before the migration becomes immutable](mutation-test-a-migrations-verification-script.md): apply deliberate defects (drop a FORCE, remove a NULLIF, widen a grant, drop an index) to copies of the migration and require the checks to fail on each, before the migration is applied anywhere. RECOMMENDED.
